name: Keeper
summary: Keeper's business plans run from $2 to $6 per user a month, billed annually, and single sign-on, SCIM and directory sync come only with Enterprise. Reporting for security tools, dark web monitoring and compliance reports are paid add-ons on every plan.

facts.text: Keeper states that its government platform holds FedRAMP High and GovRAMP High authorization and runs in AWS GovCloud (US).
Keeper's cryptographic module is FIPS 140-3 validated under NIST certificate 4743.
Keeper describes itself as HIPAA compliant and says it does not sign business associate agreements because it is not a Business Associate.
Keeper published an advisory for a clickjacking issue shown at DEF CON 33, rated it low severity, and fixed it in browser extension version 17.1.2.
The Business and Enterprise plans include a free Keeper Family Plan for every user.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Billed annually. Bought through a quote request.

hiddenCosts: Single sign-on (SAML 2.0), SCIM provisioning and Active Directory sync are on the Enterprise plan only.
Sending events to a SIEM needs the Advanced Reporting and Alerts add-on at $12 per user a year.
BreachWatch dark web monitoring is $24 per user a year and Compliance Reports are $12 per user a year.
Business Starter stops at 10 users; larger teams move to Business.

contract.cancellation: Either party can decline renewal with written notice at least 30 days before the renewal date; fees are nonrefundable.
contract.dataExport: CSV, JSON, PDF or an encrypted KeePass file; only the KeePass file includes attachments.
